answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the umber graph. Re-attestations are stored in nadir and voyage lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 23 dollars and 5 days per identity, which turns a 747 account sybil into a 4 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
